description: Validate and apply a promo code to the cart (server-checked). Returns the new discount/shipping/total, or applied=false with a reason. Args: code.

name: apply_promo

error.description: Present when the cart is empty or code is missing.

reason.description: Why the code was rejected (when applied=false).

title: Apply promo code
